answer_1.quote: Code generation is a challenging task that requires strong reasoning abilities... Our NL-DEBUGGING framework debugs code at the natural language level... regenerating the corrected code using the refined natural language representation

answer_2.quote: We use two common evaluation metrics to assess code correctness: pass rate and pass@1... pass rate is the average percentage of private test cases the generated programs pass... pass@1 is the percentage of problems where the generated programs pass all private test cases
